title: EVO installation manifest
description: Written to .evo/manifest.json by evo install and updated by evo sync. Records the installed EVO snapshot and the hash of every EVO-owned file. Contains no secrets, no credentials, no local filesystem paths, and no customer data.

install_source.description: Portable identity of the EVO source. The local checkout path is deliberately not recorded: it is true only on the machine that ran install. Version and commit are recorded at the top level as evo_version and source_commit.

repository_url.description: Source repository remote URL with any embedded credential stripped, or null when the source has no remote.

source_commit.description: Git commit of the EVO source checkout at install or last sync, when the source is a Git repository.

profiles.description: Resolved profile names, base first, in dependency order.

last_sync_at.description: UTC ISO 8601, null until the first sync.

hash_algorithm.description: Integrity algorithm the hashes in `files` were computed with, and the algorithm an integrity check must use. `sha256-canonical-eol` normalizes CRLF to LF for EVO-owned text files before hashing and hashes everything else byte for byte, so a target repository's line-ending policy cannot manufacture false drift. `sha256-raw` is byte-for-byte hashing as written by EVO 0.1.0; a schema 1.0.0 manifest has no such field and is read as `sha256-raw`. See ADR-0009.

files.description: EVO-owned file paths relative to the project root, using forward slashes, mapped to lowercase SHA-256 hex digests computed under `hash_algorithm`. Project-owned files are never listed here.
